title: Phool Aur Angaar
desc: A young man rescues a woman from being molested but gets accused of the heinous crime instead. Trying to apprehend the miscreants, he gets caught in a web of deception and lies.

title: Doosri Dulhan
desc: Renu and her husband, Anil, are devastated when she cannot bear children after a miscarriage. But soon, he visits a brothel and asks young Chanda to carry and give birth to a baby for his family.

title: Aa Gale Lag Jaa
desc: Roshni, a rich girl, is adamant on marrying Suraj, who is poor, until her mother reveals that his father is a former convict. Later, people around them are brutally killed by a seemingly unstoppable assailant.

title: Tawaif
desc: Due to unforeseen circumstances, Dawood accepts Sultana, a courtesan, as his wife in spite of being in love with author Kaynat. His life soon changes when he finds himself falling for Sultana.

title: Aadmi
desc: Vijay, a factory supervisor, is falsely accused and arrested for killing his family. Just when he is at his lowest point, an inspector offers to help him in return for capturing the son of a gangster.
